question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Exaggeration
solution:
The correct answer is '**Amplification'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Exaggeration**," means a statement that represents something as better or worse than it really is. (अतिशयोक्ति)
 
• The correct synonym is "**Amplification**," meaning the action of enlarging upon or adding detail to a story or statement. (Hindi: विस्तार)
 
• Hence, the correct synonym is: '**Amplification**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• "**Segregation**" means the action or state of setting someone or something apart. (विभाजन)
 
• "**Addition**" means the action or process of adding something. (जोड़ना)
 
• "**Fortification**" means the act of strengthening something. (प्रबलीकरण)
